request.instructions: Classify the user's utterance. Choose the best matching category.
candidates: Interrupt — While the assistant is busy, the user explicitly asks it to stop or change its current action immediately.
Discard — The utterance has no understandable communicative meaning.
Enqueue — An understandable request, question, statement, or answer. Short utterances can be complete.
Continue listening — An unfinished utterance that needs more words before its intended meaning can be understood.
